findings.finding: Client source contains plaintext demo seed passwords in SEED_DATA_SUMMARY.
findings.current_behavior: Admin123!, Panitia123!, Evaluator123!, and Wasit123! are embedded in browser-bundled source when imported.
findings.expected_behavior: No reusable credentials should be stored in client source; synthetic fixture credentials belong in controlled test tooling/secrets.
findings.impact: Credential disclosure and accidental reuse risk
findings.recommended_future_action: Remove client-visible passwords and isolate synthetic fixture credentials in authorized test-only tooling.

findings.finding: Duplicate-event caller passes a five-argument contract to the canonical three-argument boolean function.
findings.current_behavior: Application expects an array of duplicate records.
findings.impact: Runtime error or failed duplicate protection
findings.recommended_future_action: Resolve in a separately authorized application phase; do not alter canonical SQL.

findings.finding: Most domain data access bypasses repository abstractions and calls Supabase directly from hooks/pages.
findings.evidence: 229 direct table/RPC references in 33 source files
findings.current_behavior: Authorization and error handling are distributed.
findings.expected_behavior: A consistent repository/service boundary should make RLS and contracts auditable.
findings.recommended_future_action: Introduce repository boundaries in a future phase.

findings.finding: Application still references increment_view_count and public_system_settings, which are not canonical D1-D.4 objects.
findings.current_behavior: Calls may fail against the reconstructed canonical schema.
findings.expected_behavior: Use only canonical functions/views or separately governed application contracts.
findings.recommended_future_action: Resolve contract ownership before implementation changes.

service_role.evidence: supabase/functions use SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY via Deno.env; no VITE service key found
